body.summary: Jeon Somi, working a one-day part-time shift at an Olive Young store, carries a few skincare boxes (a blue one and a pink one) near the face mask aisle and jokes that she can't lose her skin elasticity even as a part-timer; the products aren't named and their labels can't be read.
body.translation: [Can't lose elasticity even as a part-timer] For elasticity...
body.captions: [لا يمكنني فقدان مرونة بشرتي حتى لو كنت أعمل بدوام جزئي] من أجل المرونة...
